title: Planted-Signal Recovery and Power Tests
negative_results: a method with no power on planted data (noise or constant decoder) is refused as vacuous (refuse_vacuous_method); its null result may not be reported as a negative finding
a noise decoder stays within the null margin of the chance rate on planted data (the null control), so a positive power result is meaningful
power_test on a non-PlantedDataset, and a planted_label with num_classes < 2, are refused

claims.statement: The decoder that knows a planted deterministic mapping recovers it on TRAIN (recovery 1.0, well above the 1/num_classes chance rate), so the pipeline has power: it can detect a signal known to be present (POWER).
A pure-noise decoder does not recover the planted mapping (stays at chance), so a null result from a method that HAS power is a finding about the material rather than blindness in the pipeline.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic opaque ids and integer labels only, no private inputs, no real coordinates
